app_summary: A social network with unidirectional follow relationships, implemented with loosely-coupled microservices, communicating with each other via Thrift RPCs. Supported Operations: Create text post (optional media: image, video, shortened URL, user tag), Read post, Read entire user timeline, Receive recommendations on which users to follow, Search database for user or post, Register/Login using user credentials, Follow/Unfollow user

symptoms.potential_symptom: compose-post-service outbound RPC failures to text-service causing post composition attempts to fail
symptoms.evidence: compose-post-service pod logs (multiple entries): 'TSocket::open() connect() <Host: text-service Port: 9090>: Connection refused' and '[error]: (ClientPool.h:114:Pop) Failed to connect text-service-client' repeated dozens of times (timestamps 10:49:00–10:49:08). Jaeger trace 00eafe1bebd776ae shows nginx-thrift -> compose-post-service in the failing call path and nginx span tags include http.status_code=500 and error=true.

symptoms.potential_symptom: text-service appears not to be accepting connections on port 9090 (connection refused) or not serving requests despite pod Running
symptoms.evidence: compose-post-service logs show repeated 'Connection refused' to text-service:9090. text-service pod logs contain only startup info '[info]: Starting the text-service server...' with no further activity or errors, suggesting it may not be listening on the expected port or not fully initialized.

symptoms.potential_symptom: nginx-thrift returning HTTP 500 for /wrk2-api/post/compose (errors surfaced to clients)
symptoms.evidence: Jaeger traces for nginx-thrift show multiple error traces (e.g., traceID 00eafe1bebd776ae) with span tags http.status_code=500 and error=true; trace sequences: 'nginx-thrift -> compose-post-service -> unique-id-service -> media-service -> user-service' indicating upstream RPC failures cause nginx 500 responses.
